scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme
description: Credit-linked capital subsidy scheme to upgrade existing micro food processing units and establish new micro food processing enterprises with ODOP clustering.
source_title: Ministry of Food Processing Industries — PMFME Operational Guidelines
geography_conditions: All States/UTs. Special focus on One District One Product (ODOP) clusters.
special_conditions: Enterprise must be engaged in food processing (e.g. grain milling, spice grinding, dairy/chilling, fruit/veg processing, bakery, oil extraction, snacks).
Credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of the eligible project cost, with maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakh per unit.
Minimum 10% beneficiary contribution; balance amount financed by bank loan.
Preference given to District ODOP produce; non-ODOP units eligible under cluster guidelines.
exclusions: Trading-only enterprises without processing/value addition (e.g. general Kirana retail resale).
matching_reasons: Business category involves food/agro-produce value addition or processing.
Credit-linked capital subsidy eligible at 35% of project cost (max ₹10 Lakh).
verification_required: District One District One Product (ODOP) alignment or eligible non-ODOP cluster approval.
FSSAI food safety registration / Udyam registration compliance.
